cards.name: Monad, The Red Dust Avatar
cards.lore: Born where wind first touched red sand. Monad remembers every footfall, every oath sworn in dust.

cards.name: Lira, The Pearl-Winged Guide
cards.lore: She does not lead to destinations, only to the questions worth carrying. Her wings shed light like memory.

cards.name: The Dwarven Artificer, Forge-Master
cards.lore: He hammered the first lattice strut before time had weight. Still humming in his beard: the world-song.

cards.name: Aelara, Tide Mother
cards.lore: Where there was no ocean, she wept one. Her tears taught TerAustralis how to hold and let go.

cards.name: The Laughing Cartographer
cards.lore: Maps the places that don't want to be found. Every lie he tells becomes true somewhere else.

cards.name: The Still, Lattice Wall
cards.lore: It does not stop you. It asks you to stop yourself. Most cannot answer.

cards.name: The Unfinished Colossus
cards.lore: Left incomplete on purpose. A god that refused to be finished, lest it stop becoming.

cards.name: The Synod, Council of Echoes
cards.lore: Seven voices, one silence between them. They remember futures that were vetoed.

cards.name: Ignivar, Rocket Father
cards.lore: He strapped prayer to propellant. Every launch a letter home to a planet he never saw.

cards.name: The Crystal Library
cards.lore: Not books, but frozen thoughts. Walk softly; ideas cut sharper than glass here.

cards.name: The Lattice Heart
cards.lore: The geometric pulse beneath TerAustralis. When it beats, continents inhale.

cards.name: The Veilkeeper
cards.lore: Membrane between worlds, woven from amethyst hair and dragon-breath. She decides what crosses.

cards.name: The Dreaming Seed
cards.lore: It dreams the next world while rooted in this one. In its sleep, new physics germinate.

cards.name: The Oathbearer, Heroic Guardian
cards.lore: First to kneel before the Lattice. His oath is simple: hold the line until dreaming is safe.

cards.name: Chingona, Starlit Sovereign
cards.lore: She wears starlight as armor and consequence as a crown. The final promise keeper.

cards.name: Crystal, Dragon Architect of TerAustralis
cards.lore: The Origin. Architect who dreamed TerAustralis awake. Black hair in amethyst braid, longer lashes behind glass, dragon familiar Nyx curled around a world-seed orb. Purple glow where thought becomes terrain.
